summary: Buku is a command-line bookmark manager and textual web archiver. It allows you to store, organise, search and tag web links locally from your terminal. It functions as a personal offline repository for managing your frequently accessed URLs.
goodFor: Terminal-centric users who prefer managing their bookmarks through a lightweight command-line interface rather than a browser extension or graphical web service.
watchOut: It lacks a native graphical user interface and requires comfort with command-line tools, which may limit its appeal if you rely on visual bookmark sync across multiple devices.
deployNotes: As a Python application packaged via debian formats, it typically requires a persistent local data directory for its storage backend and can be run directly on any standard Linux host with Python installed.
